# convoy_subscription (Resource)

A subscription routes events to an endpoint. In outgoing projects it connects an endpoint to the event types it should receive; in incoming projects it connects a source to the endpoint that receives its events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "convoy_subscription" "acme_invoices" {
  name        = "acme-invoices"
  endpoint_id = convoy_endpoint.acme.id

  filter_config = {
    event_types = ["invoice.paid", "invoice.payment_failed"]
    filter = {
      body = jsonencode({
        data = {
          amount   = { "$gte" = 1000 }
          currency = { "$in" = ["usd", "eur"] }
        }
      })
    }
  }

  retry_config = {
    type        = "exponential"
    duration    = 30
    retry_count = 10
  }

  alert_config = {
    count     = 5
    threshold = "1h"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) Endpoint that receives the events.
- `name` (String) Subscription name.

### Optional

- `alert_config` (Attributes) Failure alerting. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_config))
- `delivery_mode` (String) Delivery guarantee, `at_least_once` (default) or `at_most_once`.
- `filter_config` (Attributes) Event type and payload filtering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_config))
- `function` (String) JavaScript `transform` function applied to the payload before delivery. Requires a Convoy edition with transformations. Convoy does not support removing a function once set.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new object to be created.
- `rate_limit_config` (Attributes) Delivery rate limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limit_config))
- `retry_config` (Attributes) Retry policy, overriding the project strategy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retry_config))
- `source_id` (String) Source the events come from. Required in incoming projects.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (`uid`) of the subscription.
- `type` (String) Subscription type (`api` for subscriptions created through the API).

<a id="nestedatt--alert_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_config`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Number of failed deliveries that triggers an alert.
- `threshold` (String) Go duration over which failures are counted, e.g. `1h`.


<a id="nestedatt--filter_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter_config`

Optional:

- `event_types` (List of String) Event types delivered by the subscription. Defaults to `["*"]` (all).
- `filter` (Attributes) Payload filters. Only events matching every document are delivered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_config--filter))

<a id="nestedatt--filter_config--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter_config.filter`

Optional:

- `body` (String) Match on the event payload. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.
- `headers` (String) Match on request headers. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.
- `path` (String) Match on URL path parameters. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.
- `query` (String) Match on URL query parameters. A JSON object (use `jsonencode()`); supports Convoy filter operators such as `$gte`, `$in`, `$or`, `$regex`.



<a id="nestedatt--rate_limit_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limit_config`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Deliveries allowed per `duration`.
- `duration` (Number) Rate limit window, in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--retry_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry_config`

Optional:

- `duration` (Number) Seconds between retries.
- `retry_count` (Number) Maximum number of retries.
- `type` (String) Retry strategy, `linear` or `exponential`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import convoy_subscription.acme_invoices 01H0JA5MEES38RRK3HTEJC647K/01H0JATTVCXZK8FRDX1M1JN3QY
```
